userStories.title: Shared core: observed ledger, reconciliation, finished mode
userStories.description: As a node-room dock, I want framework-free state that remembers every receipt this mounted attempt observed (queue snapshots + local successes), a pure one-shot reconciliation against written operator ids, and a 'finished' mode gated on an explicit node-terminal input, so that both shells can deterministically recover unsent guidance without guessing.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/web/src/lib/steering-dock.test.ts is extended FIRST with failing tests T1.1–T1.22 from phase-01, then packages/web/src/lib/steering-dock.ts implements until all pass
SteeringDockState gains readonly observedLedger (ordered by first observation, deduplicated by messageId) and neverSent (null until reconciled); constructor initializes them to [] and null

resolveGuidanceSuccess and resolveSendNowSuccess append local receipts; every generation-valid applyQueueSnapshot appends all snapshot rows before replacing visible sent; stale-generation snapshots change neither; a later empty snapshot keeps prior ids in the ledger (cross-tab regression)
Only this tab's confirmed withdraw removes an id from ledger and visible state; failures, interrupts, and queue omission never remove history

reconcileNeverSent(state, { writtenMessageIds, draft }) appends in exact order: observed-unwritten rows, then pendingRetry only if its id is neither observed nor written, then current raw nonblank draft (messageId: null) only when it differs from pendingRetry.message; dedupes ids, preserves raw text/whitespace, sets neverSent to [] when nothing qualifies, is idempotent/pure and mutates no other state field

steeringDockMode returns 'finished' only when neverSent is non-empty AND an explicit nodeTerminal input is true; live:false or a terminal-looking selected row with nodeTerminal:false never selects finished; null/empty neverSent preserves the existing composer/blocked/hidden/detached/finished-iteration table
collectWrittenOperatorMessageIds collects only text rows with metadata.origin === 'operator' and a valid metadata.message_id, ignoring assistant/tool/malformed rows
Exact copy exists as constants/helpers: lowercase source heading 'never sent · n', list aria-label 'Never sent, n', disclosure 'node finished · none of this was sent'
No persistence, fetches, timers, server types, lifecycle mutation, new module, or generalized collection abstraction is added

`bun test packages/web/src/lib/steering-dock.test.ts` passes (new + existing tests), `bun --filter @archon/web type-check` is clean, and `bun x eslint packages/web/src/lib/steering-dock.ts packages/web/src/lib/steering-dock.test.ts --max-warnings 0` reports zero errors/warnings
userStories.technicalNotes: Implement phase-01-shared-core-ledger-and-reconciliation.md exactly. Files: packages/web/src/lib/steering-dock.ts and its .test.ts only. Anchors: SteeringDockState ~line 32, steeringDockMode ~112, resolveGuidanceSuccess ~286, resolveSendNowSuccess ~382, applyQueueSnapshot ~581. userStories.title: Read-only NEVER SENT box in both docks
userStories.description: As an operator using either the Legacy or Console node room, I want a read-only finished box listing exactly the receipts that were never written, rendered once with a single assertive alert and safe focus handoff, and I want attempt-scoped state reset when a new logical execution begins, so that recovery is truthful and the next attempt starts clean.
acceptanceCriteria: ComposerDock.test.tsx and ConsoleComposerDock.test.tsx are extended FIRST with equivalent failing tests T2.1–T2.18 from phase-02, then ComposerDock.tsx and ConsoleComposerDock.tsx implement until all pass in both files

Both docks accept optional props writtenOperatorMessageIds?: ReadonlySet<string> | null (default null), nodeTerminal?: boolean (default false), nodeExecutionKey?: string | null (default null) — Phase 3 supplies the real values

Reconcile effect invokes reconcileNeverSent only when: writtenOperatorMessageIds non-null, neverSent still null, nodeTerminal true, withdrawingMessageId null, and this run/node attempt previously rendered composer, blocked, or finished-iteration (per-attempt queueWasObservable ref; always-detached rooms are ineligible, observer-then-detached retains history)
While an own withdraw is in flight, terminal evidence does not reconcile; withdraw success omits the id, failure restores it after the transient clears (T2.17)

Finished branch renders in each dock locally (shared shape, no cross-boundary component): existing queue-band surface with top rule, lowercase source heading styled uppercase,
    with single-line/elided items and data-message-id only on identified entries, then exactly one

    node finished · none of this was sent

    ; no textarea, status region, badge, delete, Stop, Queue, or Send-now control; alert DOM node identity stable across rerenders

Control-presence helper counts finished-iteration as mounted (Go button focusable) and finished as not mounted, so field→finished and Go→finished transitions use the existing focus handoff to the last transcript row/scroller — never body or the box

Replacing one non-null nodeExecutionKey with another for the same run/node resets attempt state even on terminal→terminal renders and regardless of neverSent value; terminal true→false remains a fail-safe only when no key is available; reset keeps raw draft but writes { draft, pendingRetry: null } to the existing run/node session-storage record (explicit null write not overwritten by a stale-UUID effect in the same render); observed history, neverSent, and queueWasObservable clear
A same-key Ask resume and occurrence-only selection do NOT reset; run/node change clears history and hydrates that scope's saved draft

A local attempt generation increments at the prop boundary (synchronously or in layout effect); every queue-read, Queue, Send-now, withdraw, and interrupt continuation captures it and performs no state/draft/focus/storage work after it changes; execution key is in polling-effect dependencies so cleanup aborts the old poller; dock is not remounted by execution key
Once reconciled, later queue polling/rerenders cannot reorder or mutate the finished list (T2.16)

`NODE_ENV=development bun test packages/web/src/components/workflows/ComposerDock.test.tsx` and `NODE_ENV=development bun test packages/web/src/experiments/console/components/ConsoleComposerDock.test.tsx` pass including existing refusal/interrupt/blocked/detached/iteration/keyboard/storage tests; `bun test packages/web/src/experiments/console/console-isolation.test.ts` passes; `bun --filter @archon/web type-check` clean; focused eslint on the four files at --max-warnings 0 is clean

Order effects so run/node and execution-key reset runs before observation marking (or declare reset effect first) so a new-attempt render cannot set queueWasObservable then have it cleared. userStories.title: Server projection: scoped purged/answered Ask closure
userStories.description: As the run-detail API consumer, I want the existing execution-history read projection to close exactly the executions a transactionally purged parked Ask or a proven resumed Ask supersedes — including uniquely proven loop owners — so terminal evidence exists for parked-Ask cancellation without any lifecycle writes, while ambiguous data stays open.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/server/src/routes/workflow-execution-history.test.ts is extended FIRST with failing tests T3.1–T3.4 from phase-03, then workflow-execution-history.ts implements until all pass

For kind:'ask', status:'purged' interactions with a complete execution_scope (node id + occurrence_id + attempt_id): project only the matching open execution as failed with ended_at from a parseable non-null resolved_at (normalize Date to ISO) and duration only from retained valid ordered endpoints; allow the existing one-unambiguous-same-node/same-occurrence adoption for re-ask scope rollover with stale start timing cleared

For a purged scope with loop_ancestry: use ordered ancestry prefixes plus raw start kind/iteration to fail every uniquely matched open pre-resolution loop-owner execution (the owning loop iteration and, when present, the normal loop's outer node_started container); never close a sibling or infer ownership from node id alone; zero or multiple candidates for an owner leave it open

For kind:'ask', status:'answered' with a valid resolved_at: require the matching persisted interaction_resolved event (same node and tool_use_id, kind:'ask', resumed:true) plus a later corresponding lifecycle start before retiring a matching open pre-resolution segment; prompt scopes match occurrence/attempt + later node_started; loop scopes apply the same ancestry-prefix ownership rules per owner each requiring its own later start; resumed:false, no later start, or ambiguous candidates change nothing; all resumed/later executions are kept
Missing scope/resolution time, permission kind, sibling node, unmatched scope, multiple candidates, and pending interactions never terminalize an execution (fail closed)

The projection stays read-only: tests assert input events/interactions are unchanged and no lifecycle row is fabricated; no route, schema, executor, registry, database write, generated-type, query, or wire-field changes

File-local indexes by event kind, node, scope, ancestry prefix, iteration, and tool id are built once and shared between purge and answer handling — no cross-module abstraction or public field, no nested whole-list scans
`bun test packages/server/src/routes/workflow-execution-history.test.ts` passes, `bun --filter @archon/server type-check` is clean, and focused eslint on both files at --max-warnings 0 is clean
userStories.technicalNotes: Implement phase-03 section A exactly, in projectWorkflowExecutionHistory (packages/server/src/routes/workflow-execution-history.ts ~line 142; existing execution_scope handling ~247). Handle purged/answered Ask rows after lifecycle pairing, before returning history. Use real PendingInteraction and WorkflowEventRow shapes in tests. This is a read-model fix, NOT autonomous lifecycle mutation — consume committed state only. A legacy parked Ask without complete scope stays visibly unsettled intentionally (bounded 3 s catch-up preferred over a fabricated terminal).

userStories.title: Raw-history helpers + terminal catch-up in both parents
userStories.description: As the run-detail views, I want shared raw-history helpers that detect unsettled/terminal node executions and a stable logical execution key, plus a 3 s read-only catch-up while a terminal run still has unsettled raw executions, so both Legacy and Console reliably observe the real node terminal event without mutating lifecycle.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/web/src/lib/execution-room-model.test.ts is extended FIRST with failing tests T3.5–T3.9, WorkflowExecution.test.tsx and RunDetailPage.test.tsx with T3.10–T3.14, then implementation makes all pass

hasUnsettledNodeExecutions(executions): undefined/empty/all-terminal → false; running/awaiting/pending/unknown-future statuses → true; one shared terminal predicate where only completed/failed/skipped are terminal
hasTerminalNodeEvidence(executions, nodeId): missing node or any nonterminal execution → false; ≥1 execution all terminal → true; sibling node history cannot mark the selected node terminal

latestNodeExecutionKey(events, nodeId): sorts by event_order then timestamp then persisted id (not array order); a normal exact-node node_started adopts nonempty data.occurrence_id or event-id fallback; an exact-node interaction_resolved with data.kind === 'ask' && data.resumed === true arms one continuation so the next same-node node_started retains the prior key (or adopts identity when no earlier key); an exact-node terminal or node_retry_requested clears an unused marker; loop-iteration starts, sibling events, and client time are ignored
WorkflowExecution keeps the existing live 3 s refetchInterval and ALSO refetches every 3 s when the run is terminal with any raw unsettled execution; stops when all settle; unmount clears the timer

RunDetailPage preserves SSE and the existing 30 s live heartbeat and adds a DISTINCT 3 s invalidation interval only for terminal + raw unsettled; never stacked with the live heartbeat; cleared on settlement/unmount

Both parents make no periodic terminal request when raw history is settled or empty (T3.14); no timeout inference, backoff policy, background service, inferred failure, or run/status mutation is added — tests use fake timers and never expect a status write
Settled projected nodeStates are never used as terminal proof — only raw nodeExecutions/events

userStories.description: As the node-room wrappers, I want to derive the selected node's terminal signal and logical execution key from raw event-backed history and pass both through to pane and dock under a stable run/node dock key, so terminality is exact-node, occurrence selection never discards observed history, and missing legacy data defaults safe.

userStories.title: Node-wide reconciliation drain in both panes
userStories.description: As the transcript panes, I want a separate node-wide message drain that starts only after real node-terminal evidence and publishes written operator ids to the dock only on complete success, with bounded 1 s retry and full reset/abort semantics, so reconciliation input is always truthful and stale work can never corrupt a new attempt.
acceptanceCriteria: NodeTranscriptPane.test.tsx and ConsoleNodeRoom.test.tsx are extended FIRST with the same failing cases T3.18–T3.26, then both panes implement until all pass
nodeTerminal:false — including run cancelled or a completed selected row — never starts or publishes reconciliation (T3.18)

At false→true the pane calls drainNodeMessages with a kind:'node' selection whose rowId scopes to run/node/execution key; loader options omit occurrenceId and attemptId even when a finished occurrence is selected; displayed occurrence transcript rows/state/polling/scroll/Retry are unchanged (T3.19)

collectWrittenOperatorMessageIds(rows) is published to the dock only after complete:true and error:null; a complete result lacking an observed id yields the finished box, a node-wide operator row with that id yields none, and assistant/tool/malformed metadata ids never count as delivery (T3.20–T3.22)

On error or non-aborted incomplete result the pane publishes nothing and schedules another node-wide drain after 1 s while mounted/terminal, cleared on cleanup — read-only recovery, not lifecycle inference (T3.23)

Run/node change, nodeExecutionKey change, nodeTerminal true→false, or unmount aborts the controller, clears retry timer and written-id state, and ignores late promise completion; an already-terminal changed execution starts its new drain without requiring an observed false→true edge; occurrence-only selection and same-key Ask resume do NOT reset (T3.24, T3.25)
A receipt observed in the read-only finished-iteration band is compared against node-wide rows and restored after the overall node evidence (T3.26)

The drain's intermediate state never feeds transcript rendering; reconciliation state/ref is separate from displayed pageState; drain uses the existing sequential 100-row paginated loader to a captured high-water mark — no new route or unpaginated read
The dock receives the terminal signal, execution key, and written-id set; dock+drain use run/node identity while displayed transcript keeps occurrence-scoped identity

userStories.title: Real-executor E2E, evidence, authority sync, tracker closeout
userStories.description: As the release gate, I want real-executor Playwright proof of the user outcome on both shells, visual/accessibility evidence, corrected current-authority docs, and the Story 2.11 tracker flipped only after every repository gate passes.
acceptanceCriteria: e2e/ui/agent-never-sent.spec.ts is created with executable E4.1–E4.5, E4.7, E4.8 cases run for surface of ['console','legacy'] using the repo's `[P1] [V:...]` title convention; e2e/ui/agent-queue-guidance.spec.ts gains the E4.6 natural-drain negative; e2e/ui/agent-finished-iteration.spec.ts gains the finished-iteration observer case — no test.fixme placeholders

Cancel tests observe two milestones: at run cancelled with raw execution still running the UI must NOT show NEVER SENT; only after expect.poll on getRunDetail shows persisted event_type === 'node_failed' for the selected step_name AND the selected raw execution is failed does the box assert — dag_node_failed log labels and fixed sleeps are never accepted

E4.1 queued messages survive Cancel: two exact queued messages with captured request ids → abandon → wait real node event → ordered `Never sent, 2` with exact ids/text, one alert, no controls, no matching operator rows. E4.2 observer tab recovers a creator-tab receipt by id after creator closes (observation-based ledger). E4.3 idle-after-interrupt guidance added via authenticated starterFetch intent:'queue' shows under WILL SEND then restores after abandon + node event (no UI Send now click). E4.4 half-typed raw draft `  still typing  ` folds in last as an id-less item preserving whitespace. E4.5 finished-iteration observer: queue A while iteration 2 live, select completed iteration 1, confirm read-only band shows A, focus Go, cancel, wait overall node failure event, assert one Never-sent result for A, focus reaches transcript target not body, comparison request omits occurrence filters
E4.6 natural delivery: both tracked ids exist as operator rows and no Never-sent list/disclosure appears after node/run completion (AC5)

E4.7 focus + single announcement: field focused before terminal → focus lands on last transcript row/scroller (never body or the box) and exactly one alert persists across an unrelated rerender/refetch

E4.8 visual/responsive evidence: finished box captured at 460 px in both shells and Console in a 1440 px host; measurements prove ≤33vh bound, no horizontal overflow or focusable controls, computed uppercase + 0.07em tracking, item elision, and secondary-text/elevated-background contrast ≥ 4.5:1; captures land under plans/260920-1136-issue-191-recover-never-sent-messages/reports/evidence/
